final: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) as group_avg FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.status), status_stats AS (SELECT status, AVG(group_avg) as status_avg FROM group_stats GROUP BY status), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg FROM group_stats), joined AS (SELECT gs.group_avg, CASE WHEN ss.status_avg != 0 THEN gs.group_avg / ss.status_avg ELSE NULL END as ratio, gs.group_avg - os.overall_avg as diff FROM group_stats gs JOIN status_stats ss ON gs.status = ss.status CROSS JOIN overall_stats os), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM joined WHERE group_avg > overall_avg) SELECT AVG(group_avg) as avg_kept_group_averages, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratios_to_status_averages, AVG(diff) as avg_differences_from_overall FROM filtered
